Asha: quick ping — anyone confirm if our vendor has H100 slots in eu-west1 for a Dedicated demo next week? Need ~8 GPUs tied to PO#12345. Also any ETA on the firmware push (H100-1.2) the vendor mentioned? @Tom @Priya

Tom: will check quotas + vendor right now. running a quick check: `gcloud compute project-info describe --project=redwood-inference` — will paste results in ~10m.

gcp-sales-bot: Quota request QR-4567 has been submitted to GCP support. Estimated response window: 48-72 hours. Reference: https://console.cloud.google.com/quotas/QR-4567

Priya: I opened a vendor ticket (VND-998) asking them to hold a rack and confirm firmware schedule. I can escalate to their on-call if we need Tues instead of Wed. Also can open a GCP escalation if we want to push the quota faster.

Ben: Vendor replied in the ticket: they can allocate 8 H100s by Tue if we accept a mixed-firmware window (some boards get 1.1 -> 1.2 in-place). Preferred safe date Wed for all-up firmware. I'll ask for serials and an exact ETA by EOD.

Asha: ok — is mixed-firmware acceptable for the demo? Performance needs to be stable but not full perf-testing. If Tue works with mixed, we can take it; otherwise Wed is fine. Also can someone bump QR-4567 to P1? @Priya

Priya: bumping now and pinging GCP rep (cc: support rep). Created fallback plan: if vendor can't do Tue, we can borrow 2 H100 from our us-west ephemeral demo pool (latency will be worse but works for a soft demo).

Tom: pasted quota snapshot: "GPUs: A100: 8/16 used; H100 quota 0/8 (request QR-4567 pending)". Project-level CPU quota looks fine. I can also temporarily reassign 2 H100 from the internal demo pool to the eu team if we accept cross-region latency.

Asha: thanks — that's helpful. Let's wait for vendor serials and the quota escalation. If we hear nothing by 10:00PT tomorrow, we'll pull 2 from demo pool as Priya suggested. :thumbsup:

Ben: noted, I'll update here once vendor sends serials/firmware schedule. :eyes:

gcp-sales-bot: Quota QR-4567 updated: support ticket assigned to rep "Marta L." — estimated response within 36 hours after escalation. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/tickets/QR-4567

Asha: great — thanks everyone. Closing this thread until vendor or GCP reply (will reopen if we need the fallback).
